verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
You dwell in the songs that we are singing
Rising to the Heavens
Rising to your heart

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Our praises filling up the spaces
In between our frailty and everything You are

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
You are the keeper of my heart
You are the keeper of my heart

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
'Til I rest in You
'Til I rest in You

verse.name: c1d
verse.lines:
'Til I rest in You
'Til I rest in You
Oh God

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Oh speak now for my soul is listening
Say that you have saved me
Whisper in the dark, the dark

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Cause I know that you're more than my salvation
Without You I am hopeless
Tell me who you are

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
You are the keeper of my heart
You're the keeper of my heart

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
Still my heart
Hold me close
Let me hear a still small voice

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
Let it grow
Let is rise
Into a shout
Into a cry
